the calculation of heavy-to-light form-factors in the framework of the relativistic quark-model with infrared heavy-quarks propagators, in which the infrared behaviour of heavy-quarks is properly taken into account.
the calculation of the heavy-to-light transition form factors in the framework of the quark model.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is in good agreement with the available data.
the model is a good one for the description of the form factors and semileptonic widths of and mesons and can be used as a benchmark for the study of these quantities.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the obtained form factors and the corresponding decay widths for the transitions are consistent with the data and the other theoretical approaches, whereas for transitions they are larger than those of the other approaches.
the model provides a very good description for the heavy-to-light transitions.
we have been able to reproduce all the experimental results with a single set of parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in the relativistic quark models the form factors are defined by the infrared properties of the heavy quarks.
the infrared behaviour of heavy-quark propagator plays an important role in the calculation of the heavy-to-light transition form factors.
the form factors are not very sensitive to the infrared behaviour of heavy-quark propagator and that a good description of the experimental data is possible even with a simple model.
